segments.ja311:1.1: Uṭṭhehi cora kiṃ sesi, ko attho supanena [supitena (sī.), supinena (pī. ka.)] te;
segments.ja311:1.3: Mā taṃ gahesuṃ [gaṇheyyuṃ (ka.)] rājāno, gāme kibbisakārakaṃ.
segments.ja311:2.1: Yaṃ nu [nūna (syā.)] coraṃ gahessanti, gāme kibbisakārakaṃ;
segments.ja311:2.3: Kiṃ tattha pucimandassa, vane jātassa tiṭṭhato.
segments.ja311:3.1: Na tvaṃ assattha jānāsi, mama corassa cantaraṃ;
segments.ja311:3.5: Appenti [accenti (syā.)] nimbasūlasmiṃ, tasmiṃ me saṅkate mano.
